common_frame: Cambrian Burgess Shale radiodont apex predator (compound eye and oral cone)

scale.label: 24 µm
scale.meaning: Critical wavelength lambda_c = 2*pi/k_c of a Schnakenberg activator-inhibitor field on a corneal patch. Not the ommatidial facet diameter.

equations.formula: du/dt = Du * laplacian(u) + a - u + u^2 v; dv/dt = Dv * laplacian(v) + b - u^2 v
k_c^2 = (Dv f_u + Du g_v) / (2 Du Dv); lambda_c = 2 pi / k_c
equations.instability: (Dv f_u + Du g_v)^2 > 4 Du Dv det(J) and trace(J) < 0 and det(J) > 0

equations.formula: sigma(q) from the Jacobian shifted by Du,Dv times the stencil symbol L(q) = 2 (cos q - 1)

boundary_conditions.corneal_patch: no-flux (Neumann) on a rectangular patch of corneal epithelium
boundary_conditions.dispersion_calibration: periodic interval, so the finite-difference symbol is exact
boundary_conditions.why_neumann: A sub-facet patch does not exchange morphogen with the neighbouring facet across a sealed lateral membrane on the timescale of wavelength selection.

parameters.note: a and b place the homogeneous state at (u0, v0) = (1, 0.9), where trace(J) = -0.2 and det(J) = 1. Du is then fixed so that lambda_c equals the slot length on an 8-cell wave. These are not measured Anomalocaris rate constants.

empirical_claims.claim: Emu Bay Shale (~515 Ma) eyes assigned to Anomalocaris are 2-3 cm across and carry at least 16000 hexagonal lenses in one eye.
empirical_claims.used_as: predecessor optical scale in the eye fossil series

empirical_claims.claim: Burgess Shale A. canadensis has paired stalked eyes against a small oval dorsal carapace and a triradial oral cone.
Early Ordovician (488-472 Ma) Fezouata anomalocaridids are larger than any Cambrian body.
empirical_claims.used_as: successor horizon; body size changes, tissue-local k_c does not have to

empirical_claims.claim: The Drosophila R8 crystal is a switch-and-template lattice, mathematically distinct from a Turing instability.
empirical_claims.used_as: negative transfer: this script does not claim that mechanism for Anomalocaris

empirical_claims.claim: TMP 2023.003.0003 (previously ROMIP 51211) is catalogued on Wikimedia as a Wuliuan Burgess Shale cast about 20 cm long.
empirical_claims.used_as: specimen photograph, not a 24 µm measurement

predecessor.name: Emu Bay Shale Anomalocaris eye
predecessor.change: Published observable is the facet lattice. A 2.5 cm hemisphere with 16000 hexagonal lenses reconstructs to about 266 µm center spacing, an order of magnitude above 23.97 µm.

successor.name: Fezouata anomalocaridid
successor.change: Macroscopic size increases. The cellular wavenumber k_c is fixed by Du, Dv and the Jacobian, so lambda_c stays 2.397e-05 m unless those kinetic parameters change. No successor measurement of that wavelength is published.

specimen_image.object: cast (invert) of Burgess Shale Anomalocaris canadensis, Wuliuan

does_not_claim: That Burgess Shale carbon films preserve a 24 µm pigment lattice.
That Schnakenberg a, b, Du, Dv were measured in anomalocaridid cornea.
That the Drosophila switch-and-template R8 circuit operated in A. canadensis.
That the 20 cm Commons length is a Daley & Edgecombe morphometric.
